field.name: title
field.comment: The text displayed above the tags

field.name: targetCID
field.comment: The ID of the page that the links of the block point to, where a page list block filters its pages by the chosen tag (0 or NULL: they point to the page holding the block)

field.name: displayMode
field.comment: page: the tags of the page holding the block are listed; cloud: the ones of the whole site are listed

field.name: cloudCount
field.comment: How many tags are listed at most (0 or NULL: all of them): it's used only when displayMode is cloud

field.name: titleFormat
field.comment: The HTML element wrapping the text displayed above the tags: h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 or p
